subject: english
objectives: 使用 although 引出與主句形成反差的讓步資訊。
辨識讓步不是單純並列，並避免 although 與 but 重複。

sections.title: although 承認一項事實再提出意外結果
sections.content: Although the test was hard, Mia finished it 先承認考試困難，再說 Mia 仍完成。主句不是否定 although 子句，而是呈現即使有阻礙，結果仍發生。

sections.title: although 子句可前可後
sections.content: Although it was late, we did not stop talking 與 We did not stop talking although it was late 都建立相同讓步關係。位置改變不會交換事實，只會調整讀者先接收到哪一部分。

sections.title: although 與 but 不重複使用
sections.content: Although the bag is old, it is useful 已完整。若改用 but，可寫 The bag is old, but it is useful；不能把兩個架構疊成 Although..., but...。

sections.title: 讓步需要真實的預期落差
sections.content: Although the water was cold, Ben went swimming 中，cold 構成可能阻礙，went swimming 卻仍發生。若兩項同方向，例如天氣好又出去玩，就不需要 although。

workedExamples.prompt: The rain did not stop the game: ___ it was raining, the players stayed outside. (Although / Because)
workedExamples.why: 前句明說雨沒有阻止比賽，players stayed outside 與 raining 形成讓步，因此在指定選項中用 Although。Because 會誤寫成雨造成他們留在外面。

workedExamples.prompt: Use although: Nora smiled ___ she was tired.
steps: 疲累與微笑形成預期落差。
workedExamples.why: Nora 疲累是事實，但她仍微笑；依題目指定，空格填 although，在句尾引出這項阻礙。它保留兩件事都成立，也表達預期落差。

workedExamples.prompt: Although the room was small, it ___ bright. (was / but was)
workedExamples.why: although 子句已說明房間雖小，主句直接寫 it was bright 即可。but was 會在同一讓步架構中重複加入轉折詞。

misconceptions.belief: although 表示前半句不是真的。
misconceptions.whyWrong: 讓步句承認前半事實，再指出結果仍不同於預期。
misconceptions.correction: 把兩邊都視為成立，尋找它們之間的落差。

misconceptions.belief: Although 開頭後一定要搭配 but。
misconceptions.whyWrong: although 已負責連接從句與主句。
misconceptions.correction: 寫 Although A, B，不再加入 but。

misconceptions.belief: 兩個正確事實放在一起就能使用 although。
misconceptions.whyWrong: 讓步還需要阻礙與結果間的預期反差。
misconceptions.correction: 檢查是否能自然說成「雖然 A，仍然 B」。

misconceptions.whyWrong: although 子句也可以放在主句之後。
misconceptions.correction: 比較 Although A, B 與 B although A。

checks.prompt: although 子句中的事實仍成立嗎？
Although A, but B 是否重複？
checks.reason: 兩個詞重複標記同一轉折。

checks.prompt: although 子句能放在主句後嗎？
checks.reason: 位置可變但邏輯關係不變。
